strings.legal.security.description: Ko fayi e fiilde maa e dow pdff: njuɓɓudi e yalta, alaa hiisiyagol, momtiteede e waɗde, ɓural, tagoore to Yuroopu, e feere waɗde ɗum e dow server maa.
strings.legal.security.intro: Ko fayi e fiilde maa, to nde njuɓɓetee e no nde kisniraa: ina laaɓi, ngam yimɓe e gollorɗe IT.
